answer_1.quote: We assess models on diverse medical test datasets: two multi-task, multiple-choice datasets, MMCU-Med and CMB-Exam, and an open Q&A dataset, CMB-Clin... we employ ROUGE and BLEU to assess the quality of the LLMs' responses.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to multiple-choice medical questions and open-ended medical Q&A.

answer_2.quote: We employ ROUGE-R and Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) to assess the quality of the LLMs' responses. For multi-task medical choice questions, we adopt Exact Match (EM) as the metric.

answer_3.quote: In addition to traditional metrics... we conduct a pair-wise comparison to more thoroughly compare the fine-tuned models' medical analysis ability. We randomly sample 100 answers from each model and employ GPT-4o, a highly capable LLM, as the judge.
